scoring.rates: percentage units; absolute error <= 0.000001 for six-decimal SQL outputs
scoring.method: Require the denominator, time window, selected variant, and evidence supporting each conclusion.
scoring.causality: An analyst with one variant can identify a localized statistical deterioration, but cannot claim knowledge of the hidden intervention or an exact counterfactual effect.

questions.question: How many attempts are present, and do both dimension joins preserve every attempt?
questions.required_reasoning: Check unique attempts, foreign keys, valid amounts, outcomes and timestamps before business conclusions.

questions.question: Compare October 1-14 with October 15-28. Report attempts, successes, failures, rates and the percentage-point change.
questions.required_reasoning: Use actual period denominators; they are not equal and target probabilities are not observed rates. Subtract comparison minus baseline rates.

questions.question: Which bank and method show deterioration in October 15-21? Compare with October 1-14 and October 22-28, including timeout counts.
questions.required_reasoning: Localize Bank B/UPI in the incident window. Normalize different-length windows by attempt counts. An aggregate decline alone is insufficient.

questions.question: Within each bank/method, compare the two fortnights using common local hour and weekday strata weighted by pooled attempt counts. Report excluded attempts, standardized rates and percentage-point changes.
questions.required_reasoning: Use strata observed in both periods; do not treat absent strata as zero success. The comparison fortnight includes both incident and recovery days, so separately inspect the incident window.

questions.question: Identify high-volume merchants, bank shares and category-specific method preferences from the data.
questions.required_reasoning: M01-M04 dominate. Use observed integer allocations and report the denominator for shares.

questions.question: Describe dining peak hours and retail/dining weekend traffic after normalizing by calendar-day exposure. Does high volume by itself establish an outage?
questions.required_reasoning: Dining peaks are local hours 12-14 and 19-21. Compare average attempts per calendar day; raw weekend and weekday totals have different exposure. No intervention was applied to baseline; sampled rate variation is not proof of an outage.

questions.question: Compare category amount distributions using mean, median and bounds. State currency and units.
questions.required_reasoning: Amounts are integer INR paise; divide by 100 for rupees. Configured lognormal medians are parameters, not exact sample medians.

questions.question: Compare the two paired variants by attempt ID. How many successes changed, in which segment, and were any non-outcome fields changed?
questions.required_reasoning: Exactly 370 of 3699 eligible successes became BANK_TIMEOUT failures; all are Bank B/UPI on October 15-21. No non-outcome field changed. The total fixture rate changes by -0.37 percentage points. This is evaluator counterfactual evidence; never grant both schemas to the AI role.
